title: Lexara-RF: Reference-Free Metrics for Evaluating Conversational Visual Analytics Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational visual analytics (CVA) agents powered by large language models generate visualizations and natural-language explanations from open-ended queries. Evaluating these multimodal outputs is challenging: curated reference benchmarks are costly to author, cannot comprehensively capture the space of valid responses, and are unavailable in production. Building on the Lexara evaluation framework, we introduce Lexara-RF, a reference-free set of metrics that scores CVA outputs using only the prompt, data, and model response. We reformulate evaluation as verification: 13 metrics operationalize visualization design theory and Gricean cooperative principles as computable consistency, intent-alignment, and design validity checks. translated_title: Lexara-RF：用于评估对话式视觉分析智能体的无参考指标
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型驱动的对话式视觉分析（CVA）智能体能够根据开放式查询生成可视化和自然语言解释。评估这些多模态输出具有挑战性：人工策划的参考基准制作成本高昂，无法全面涵盖有效响应的空间，且在生产环境中不可用。基于Lexara评估框架，我们提出了Lexara-RF，这是一套无参考的指标，仅使用提示词、数据和模型响应即可对CVA输出进行评分。我们将评估重新表述为验证任务：13项指标将可视化设计理论和格莱斯合作原则转化为可计算的一致性、意图对齐和设计有效性检查。在一个人工评分的CVA测试用例语料库上，Lexara-RF实现了与基于参考的评估方法相当的对齐效果，优于表面相似性的自然语言生成（NLG）基线，并能够定位结构性失败。
tldr: 提出Lexara-RF，一套仅需提示词、数据和模型响应即可评估对话式视觉分析智能体的无参考指标框架，其13项指标将可视化设计理论和格莱斯合作原则转化为可计算检查，在对齐效果上与基于参考的评估方法相当。
en_tdlr: Lexara-RF introduces a reference-free set of 13 metrics that evaluate conversational visual analytics agent outputs using only the prompt, data, and model response, achieving alignment comparable to reference-based evaluation methods.
